column1: # Light / derived region variants.
# A variant reuses its PARENT's extracts and Overture parquets and differs
# only in build flags. Without this table build-region-fast.sh would look for
# overture_cache/{addresses,places}-<variant>-*.parquet, which do not exist,
# and its `[ -f "$ADDR" ] &&` guard would SILENTLY drop both flags -- that is
# how the first switzerland-light build lost 748,654 Overture place records
# (9,947,615 -> 9,198,961): an empty fuel chip and nothing in the log but a
# missing argument. The wrapper now ABORTS if a parent input is absent.
# satellite: no  -> omit --satellite entirely (there is no --no-satellite)
# max_zoom:  13  -> pass --max-zoom 13 (honoured on the in-memory path since
#                   3910bfc; switzerland's mbtiles is 0.9 GB so it takes it)
# wiki_images: none -> Wikipedia articles without their pictures (WIKI_IMAGES;
#                   empty: the build's default), and the map's language packs
#                   without them too (ops/langpack/ship_packs.sh): light maps
#                   for small phones and slow networks
# id
switzerland-light
africa-light
india-northwest-light
india-central-light
india-east-light
india-northeast-light
india-south-light
india-west-light
